scope: Smoother Help reading and a clearer manual.

topics.title: A complete contents list
details: The contents now include the smaller sections within every chapter. In Word, HTML, and EPUB, you can follow links to those sections.

topics.title: Read Help without missing text
details: Up Arrow reads the previous paragraph or list item. Down Arrow reads the next one. Home and End reach the first and last blocks. Long paragraphs are read in full.
Unrecognized speech no longer stops Help to repeat a guidance prompt. Help uses the same text as the manual.

topics.title: Clearer instructions and lists
details: Instructions use phrases such as "you can say" and "from the keyboard." Menu choices use bullet points. Each separate set of steps starts at 1.
